The branch adds an optional token-specific `updatedAt` to widget token summaries, uses it to suffix stale token-cost row titles across widget layouts, clears token-fetch retry TTL after fast failures, and adds focused tests.

Reproducibility: yes. From source inspection, current main schedules token-cost refresh asynchronously and builds fresh widget snapshots from the existing `tokenSnapshots`, so stale token rows can inherit a fresh provider/widget timestamp; I did not run live WidgetKit in this read-only review.
